previous_review.scope: Rebuilt Stage48 v2 active x030 LSE/RTC optional schema and qualification projection; metapac adapted ancestry retained.

Reviewed L031/R031/W031 LSE schema: required configurable_ccs bool and gpio_speed_offset Option<u32>; input/Rust compatibility changes are explicit. Full Stage48 and earlier review history plus adapted metapac ancestry retained.

compatibility.configurable_ccs: New required bool without serde(default). Active LSE inputs lacking it fail deserialization in both input models. Does not default unknowable hardware facts. Existing no-LSE chips remain unaffected.
compatibility.gpio_speed_offset: u32 becomes Option<u32> in all three models. JSON number 8 remains number 8. Missing/null deserialize to None and serialize as explicit null because no skip_serializing_if is present. Rust literals/accessors must change to Some(8)/None.
compatibility.output_routes: Existing Vec and static slice remain unchanged; empty list is representable. Exact F8U6 absence is source/package validation, not a new default.
compatibility.field_order: configurable_ccs is consistently inserted after maximum_hz. All other LseConfiguration fields remain in the same relative order and retain their types except gpio_speed_offset.
compatibility.unknown_fields: deny_unknown_fields remains on both deserializing LSE configuration records.
compatibility.static_generation: Derived Debug/stringify has no hand-written LSE field projection; bool and Option<u32> expressions match the static model. This is code inspection only, not compiled validation.

previous_review.scope: Accepted narrow L052 schema delta: awt_source becomes Option<u8>; optional startup_consumers carries explicit native startup analog, AUTOTRIM, work-gated LPTIM/LCD, UART and package LSI-output facts. Existing eight JSON profile values remain unchanged, while Rust/API and generated Rust shape changes are explicit. Complete Stage49 and earlier replacement-review history and adapted metapac ancestry are retained.
previous_review.scope_correspondence: The schema receipt covers the unchanged exact three model hashes and its earlier generator boundary. The separate independent runtime receipt binds the final 1,153-file L052 source freeze, final electrical.rs, 899 generated inputs, nine resumed numeric exit-0 commands, retained prior C8T6 library Finished/PASS evidence without a numeric exit, and ten actual ELF files. Shared integration hook/docs changes are outside those historical build receipts.

compatibility.legacy_json: All eight old authored active profiles retain exact serde_json serialization values and field order; all 54 existing full-chip JSON documents roundtrip with no Value changes.
compatibility.rust_api: awt_source changes u8 to Option<u8> in all three models; Some(3) is required for legacy Rust callers. Addition of startup_consumers also changes struct literal construction. This is not insertion-only Rust/API compatibility.
compatibility.awt_source: A JSON number remains that number through Some. Missing and explicit null now both deserialize None in the two input models. Unlike the old required u8, those forms are accepted syntactically; None serializes as explicit null.
compatibility.startup_consumers: Missing and explicit null both deserialize None in the two input models; the serde model omits None when serializing. A present object has six required nonnullable fields, including both vectors even if empty. Inner work-gate source and boolean are required.
compatibility.required_existing_facts: configurable_ccs remains a required bool. All other nonoptional top-level fields remain required. Existing gpio_speed_offset remains nullable/omittable and emits explicit null.
compatibility.rejection: Both deserializing models reject unknown fields in LseConfiguration, LseStartupConsumers, LseWorkGatedConsumer and route/reset records; source u8 widths, bool types and roster string element types are enforced.
compatibility.static_projection: Names, declaration order, widths and nested types match exactly after Peripheral prefix/container substitutions. Vec<String> maps to static slice of static str, Vec<LseOutputRoute> to static slice, Option<native struct> stays a value Option. Actual generator Debug/stringify function compiled all 11 profile expressions against exact extracted static definitions and every projected field was compared.
compatibility.generated_rust: Legacy JSON value compatibility does not preserve generated Rust bytes: awt_source now renders Some(3), startup_consumers renders None, and derived Debug/Hash shape changes with the explicit Rust/API change.

previous_review.scope: Accepted native L010 optional fact schema only. Three-model static identity/projection review; runtime, generator execution and hardware qualification are separate. Preserve all prior review history and adapted metapac ancestry.

compatibility.legacy_json: Absent or null native_l010 deserializes None; serde omits None. Existing fields are unchanged. The old deny_unknown_fields reader rejects new objects containing the added field.
compatibility.rust_api: New optional native_l010 field affects struct literals and derived Debug/Hash/static projection; no Rust source/byte compatibility is claimed.
compatibility.native_object: All nine native fields are required/nonnullable and unknown fields are rejected; static projection preserves order and widths.

replacement_review.scope: Accepted breaking native_low_power name migration and explicit monitor qualification fields only. Integrated generator/runtime, builds and hardware acceptance remain separate. Preserve complete prior review and adapted metapac ancestry.

compatibility.serialized_api: Explicit native_l010 to native_low_power rename; no alias. Old deny_unknown_fields readers reject the new property; new readers reject the old property. Prior16 profile None remains omitted.
compatibility.native_object: Existing nine facts retained; monitor_reference and detector_margin_lse_edges required without defaults. lsi_factory_trim_address serializes None as null; omission/null deserialize None and exact factory profiles reject None via semantic validation.
compatibility.rust_api: Public metadata struct/name/field change; no source or Debug/Hash identity compatibility claimed.
